value.description: The raw HealthKit category enum integer. Absent entirely (not 0) when it is 0 — see valueName for the trap this causes in practice (e.g. AppleStandHour's "stood" value is 0).

valueName.description: The stable, non-localized HealthKit enum name, e.g. "asleepREM", "stood". Prefer this over the raw integer — it never changes across OS locales or versions.

components.description: The correlation's component samples, each a full Sample with its own uuid/source. v1 supports only blood pressure: exactly two quantity components, systolic then diastolic ordering is by VALUE (the higher reading is systolic), both in mmHg.

batchId.description: Dedupe key for the whole batch. NOT a sample key: the same sample can legitimately arrive again under a new batchId after a client-side retry.

batches.description: Samples grouped by HealthKit type. Absent entirely (not an empty array) on the zero-batch Test Connection probe — see the HTTP contract.

deviceId.description: Keychain-stable UUID identifying the sending device. Stable across reinstalls; not a secret.

schemaVersion.description: Wire format version. Always "v1" — reject anything else.

sentAtUnixMs.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the client sent this envelope.

value.description: The measurement. Absent entirely (not 0) when the true value is zero — proto3 canonical JSON omits default-valued scalars. Treat a missing value as 0, not as "no data".

courseDeg.description: Direction of travel, degrees. Negative means invalid — do not treat it as a real reading.

speedMps.description: Ground speed, metres/second. Negative means invalid — do not treat it as a real reading.

verticalAccuracyM.description: Vertical accuracy, metres. Negative means invalid — do not treat it as a real reading.

activityType.description: The parent workout's activity type, denormalized here for convenience.

points.description: Ordered oldest-to-newest location points. May be downsampled on-device — treat point_count/distance as describing the delivered path, not a guaranteed raw series.

workoutUuid.description: Foreign key: the uuid of the workout Sample this route belongs to.

category.description: Present when this sample is a HealthKit category value (sleep stage, stand hour, ...). Exactly one of quantity/category/workout/correlation/route is ever present.

correlation.description: Present when this sample is a HealthKit correlation (v1: blood pressure). Exactly one of quantity/category/workout/correlation/route is ever present.

endUnixMs.description: Sample end time, Unix milliseconds. Equal to startUnixMs for an instantaneous sample.

quantity.description: Present when this sample is a scalar measurement (heart rate, steps, weight, ...). Exactly one of quantity/category/workout/correlation/route is ever present.

route.description: Present when this sample is a workout's GPS route. Exactly one of quantity/category/workout/correlation/route is ever present.

source.description: The HealthKit source (app/device) that recorded this sample.

uuid.description: The HealthKit sample UUID — this is the dedupe key. Delivery is at-least-once; a receiver MUST treat a repeated uuid as a no-op.

workout.description: Present when this sample is a workout summary. Exactly one of quantity/category/workout/correlation/route is ever present.

deletedUuids.description: UUIDs of samples HealthKit reported deleted for this hkTypeId since the last read. Delete or tombstone them in your store — ignoring this list leaves ghost rows behind. A repeated delete for an already-absent UUID is normal and must not be treated as an error.

hkTypeId.description: The HealthKit type identifier for every sample in this batch, e.g. "HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate".

bundleId.description: The recording app or device's bundle identifier. May be empty.

name.description: Human-readable source name, e.g. "Noe's Apple Watch". May be empty.

productType.description: Device model identifier, e.g. "Watch7,1". May be empty.

endUnixMs.description: Event end time, Unix milliseconds. Only lap and segment events span time; every other type is an instant, where this equals startUnixMs.

type.description: The event kind: "pause", "resume", "lap", "marker", "motionPaused", "motionResumed", "segment", "pauseOrResumeRequest", or "eventType<N>" for a raw HKWorkoutEventType not in that set.

activityType.description: A compact activity name from a curated set (e.g. "running", "cycling"), or "activityTypeN" for a raw HKWorkoutActivityType value not in that set. Stable but not exhaustive.

avgHeartRateBpm.description: Average heart rate over the samples HealthKit itself associates with this workout — not a time-window guess. Absent entirely (not 0) when the workout carries no heart-rate samples.

brandName.description: HKMetadataKeyWorkoutBrandName. HealthKit has no user-entered workout name; this is the closest thing it exposes, and only some third-party / gym-class / Fitness+ writers set it. Absent for most Apple Watch workouts — that is the expected steady state, not missing data.

events.description: HKWorkout.workoutEvents, ordered oldest to newest. Absent for most workouts — only laps, segments and pause/resume activity produce entries.

isIndoor.description: HKMetadataKeyIndoorWorkout. Absent and false are DIFFERENT answers here: absent means the writer never said, false means it explicitly said outdoor. Present as false on the wire when the writer said outdoor.

maxHeartRateBpm.description: Maximum heart rate over the samples HealthKit itself associates with this workout. Absent entirely (not 0) when the workout carries no heart-rate samples.

minHeartRateBpm.description: Minimum heart rate over the samples HealthKit itself associates with this workout. Absent entirely (not 0) when the workout carries no heart-rate samples.

totalDistanceM.description: Total distance, metres. 0 for a non-distance workout (absent on the wire in that case).

description: The JSON body Conduit POSTs to your webhook. Generated from proto/conduit/v1/sync.proto — see PAYLOADS.md for the human-readable reference.
title: Conduit webhook envelope
